description: Create a Pinterest conversion TAG on the ad account — the base code a website installs so Pinterest sees page visits, sign-ups and checkouts, and a WEB_CONVERSION / SALES campaign has something to optimise for. Returns the tag id and the code snippet to paste into every page’s <head>, READ BACK from Pinterest. enhancedMatch:true (or a per-field object) turns on Pinterest’s Automatic Enhanced Match. Spends nothing, 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

enhancedMatch.description: true enables all Automatic Enhanced Match fields; or an object to enable individual fields

name.description: tag name, as shown in Pinterest Ads Manager

name: create_pinterest_ads_conversion_tag
title: Create a Pinterest conversion tag
